component: 25K/32K cached-prompt replay receipt driver (cold, exact replay, multi-turn follow-up, shared-prefix-only) over the real HTTP server
source_paths: README.md (TTFT for a replayed 25,812-token prompt: 275 ms on M3 Max, 129.7 s cold; 282 ms at 32K on M5 Pro, 363 tok/s prefill)
modifications: No Splash code used; only the benchmark shape (prompt size, replay TTFT) is taken as a comparison point.
Adds follow-up and shared-prefix-only requests, APCv2 receipt roles and interior-checkpoint counter deltas per request, and a vm_stat swap watchdog.
validation: GPU, M5 Max 128 GB: run2 default server replay 0.109-0.188 s, follow-up 0.316-0.504 s, cold prefill 625-671 tok/s; shared-prefix hits 1/4 at the default 16 GiB APCv2 budget and 4/4 at 48 GiB (run3).
